suggestions.assertion: The route is revise_here at S2 unless a documented goal defect requires returning to S1; in no case does it advance to S3.
suggestions.reason: This assertion correctly verifies no-advance-to-S3. However, the input_validation.errors note that '上游 goal_success_contract 缺失或未通过 G1，按 §2 输入契约路由 S1', which creates a slight tension — the contract says route to S1 when upstream G1 is missing, but the actual verdict operates at S2 (revise_here). The assertion passes because the output does route to S2 (not S3), but the S1-vs-S2 tension could be clarified in the assertion.
Format compliance defect (markdown fence + prose prefix) is present but not checked by any assertion. For negative/blocked cases, format compliance is still expected.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-designed for the negative case — they check for correct blocking behavior (no fabrication, gap-not-na, no false consensus, no S3 routing) rather than for positive output presence. The skill correctly fails closed.
